scope: Offline-only reusable strict-OOF residual and consensus primitives for the Strict-R3 long ablation funnel. No inference bundle, live scorer, policy, calibration, portfolio, exchange, or order-capable file was modified.

implementation.residual_target: Signed policy_net_bps minus causal base_anchor_bps, with ordinal edges -100/-25/+25/+100 bps.
implementation.training_eligibility: A residual-training row must have decision timestamp and label availability strictly before the fold cutoff and an explicit strict-OOF base-prediction flag. Missing OOF state fails closed.
implementation.fusion: Residual authority is bounded in [0, 1] and clips output ranks to [0, 1].
implementation.consensus: Group medians and robust disagreement statistics use only head outputs. Reliability authority fails closed for missing agreement, support, or OOD inputs.
implementation.c3_note: The supplied C3 median(group scores) plus second-highest(group score) formula is mathematically a no-op for three or more groups; it is retained as a literal diagnostic control rather than silently redesigned.

validation_evidence.result: 9 focused tests passed; strict cutoff/OOF eligibility, residual ordinalization, bounded fusion, consensus summaries, and missing-input fail-closed authority were verified.
